Snapshot: financial research/knowledge portal for institutional clients. Primary need: very large-scale embeddings index + reranking layer with strict data residency and KMS controls. Preference for Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput, private VPC) — will consider Private on prem for top-tier banking clients.

Scale & performance requirements (customer-provided):
- Initial index: ~35M documents (research notes, filings, transcripts). Expected to grow to 150-200M in 12-18 months.
- Query profile: mixed analytic queries + conversational search. Avg QPS expected 15-40 for hosted portal, spikes to 200 for batch re-ranks during overnight jobs.
- Latency targets: embeddings + ANN lookup + rerank end-to-end <= 120ms p95 for portal queries; <= 300ms p99 for higher-fidelity rerank flows. Prefers p95 as gating metric.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (embeddings+rerank) < $0.02 for interactive queries; lower for bulk batch jobs (they expect to trade-off cost vs accuracy).
- Model preference: open/quantized Llama-family variants acceptable; want ability to pin model versions and fallback to smaller variants during contention.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must keep client-provided data resident in region (US East + EU-West segregation). No uncontrolled cross-border copying; CTO quote: "no client PII leaves region without explicit consent."
- KMS mandatory for key separation per client; HSM preferred for top 3 banks. Need integration plan and timeline before procurement sign-off.
- Audit logging and retention policy required for 7 years for regulated customers; Redwood logs must be exportable.

POC plan (proposed): 4-week scoped POC: index 5M docs in US region on Dedicated capacity (small pool), run baseline ANN + learned reranker, measure p50/p95/p99 and cost per query. Week-by-week deliverables and handoff to Aurora infra. Pricing deck shared (drive:/Aurora/Redwood_Pricing_POC_v2.pdf).
